method_note: The point is the official Vicmap Address record for '578 LORIMER STREET PORT MELBOURNE 3207' (Victoria Department of Transport and Planning, Vicmap Address, served by the Victorian open-data GeoServer WFS layer open-data-platform:address at opendata.maps.vic.gov.au), the street address Equinix gives for both ME1 and ME2 on its own IBX pages (Internet Archive raw copies of 3 October 2026; www.equinix.com answers robots.txt with HTTP 403, so the live pages were not requested). It was queried by road name, locality and house number with srsName=EPSG:4326 and copied without transformation; the same record requested in the layer's native CRS (EPSG:7844, GDA2020) returns identical coordinate digits. The property (layer open-data-platform:v_property_mp, by the address record's property_pfi) and the parcel (layer open-data-platform:parcel_view, point-intersect at the address point) were captured for the identity check. Polygons were projected from the served EPSG:4326 coordinates to GDA2020 / MGA zone 55 (EPSG:7855) with pyproj 3.7.1 and measured with shapely 2.1.1 for the checks below only. No commercial map, map embed or map-widget parameter, short link, PeeringDB record or OpenStreetMap service was used; no token or key was used. Licence: DataVic lists Vicmap Address (Department of Transport and Planning) under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (dataset page captured 7 November 2026, local local_data/country-research-equinix-apac-2-p13/datavic-dataset-vicmap-address.html).
site_versus_campus_review: Equinix gives the same street address, 578 Lorimer Street, Port Melbourne VIC 3207, for ME1 (a 2-storey building, 3,326 m2 colocation space) and ME2 (a 5-storey building, 8,172 m2 colocation space), and each page's related-IBX block places the other in Port Melbourne. Vicmap holds one property for the address (property_pfi 221794916, a single 2.49 ha parcel, parcel pfi 221794912) with two address records: the primary '552-578 LORIMER STREET' (geocode_feature V) and the non-primary '578 LORIMER STREET' (geocode_feature E), 1.54 m apart. Both IBXs therefore stand on one property and are added as one campus project with a campus locator. ME4 (Derrimut, VIC 3026) and ME5 (West Melbourne, VIC 3003) are separate IBXs whose pages give no street address; they are held.

candidates.precision_scope: Official Vicmap Address record '578 LORIMER STREET PORT MELBOURNE 3207' (ufi 888094116, pfi 460240419, property_pfi 221794916; source LGO, source_verified 2026-06-24; is_primary N; geocode_feature E), the exact street address Equinix publishes for ME1 and ME2. It lies inside the single 2.49 ha property and parcel at that address (about 164 m by 255 m), 6.67 m from its nearest boundary on the Lorimer Street side and 112.7 m from its planar centroid; the property's primary virtual address point '552-578 LORIMER STREET' lies 1.54 m away. It locates the 578 Lorimer Street property shared by the ME1 and ME2 IBXs, not either building, an entrance gate as surveyed, or a data hall.
candidates.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: Vicmap Address supplies no positional accuracy for the record. The point stands near the street frontage of a 2.49 ha property that holds two IBX buildings (farthest property vertex 239.0 m away); Equinix does not publish where the ME1 and ME2 buildings stand within it.
